description: This file defines a generic static factory class for creating or retrieving instances of IMemoryMessageBodySerializer implementations, utilizing dependency injection and lazy initialization.

classes.name: MemoryMessageBodySerializerFactory<TSerializer>
classes.description: A static factory class that provides a method to get or create a serializer instance of type TSerializer, which must implement IMemoryMessageBodySerializer.

methods.name: GetOrCreateSerializer
methods.description: Returns an existing TSerializer instance from the service provider or creates a new one using a lazy-initialized factory.
